reference: Chevrolet Camaro ZL1 coupe (6th generation), LT4 6.2 L supercharged pushrod cross-plane V8 with the Eaton R1740 TVS blower and the dual-mode (valved) exhaust. Engineering reference only.

interior.source: estimate (research notes): previous-generation 2013 ZL1 convertible measured by Edmunds 53.6 / 81.9 / 69.9, adjusted for the coupe and its valved exhaust

notes.engine.firingOrder: [P] 1-8-7-2-6-5-4-3, the order of every Gen III-V GM small-block (rerev.com, Summit Racing; research_notes/cars/RefCamaroZL1).
notes.engine.banks: [P] GM numbering (Summit Racing): cylinders front to back, odd 1-3-5-7 on the left (driver's) bank, even 2-4-6-8 on the right; No. 1 is the front cylinder of the left bank.
notes.engine.crank: [E] Cross-plane: deduced from the even 90-degree firing order (every GM small-block uses one; the LT4's crank is forged steel [P]). Each bank fires at 180-270-180-90 degrees: the burble.
notes.engine.displacementCc: [F] 6,162 cc, bore x stroke 103.25 x 92.0 mm.
notes.engine.idleRpm: [E] Warm idle, not published (Gen V LT V8s idle at about 600-700 rpm); matches the car config. The reference LT4 recording's cold start holds about 1,630 rpm.
notes.engine.limiterRpm: [P] GM's 6,600 rpm maximum engine speed for the LT4 (tachometer redline 6,500 rpm [P]); fuel-cut limiter assumed there [E]. Matches the car config.
notes.exhaust.collectors: [F]/[E] GM: Tri-Y exhaust manifolds that improve 'torque production and sound quality' (bulletin 17-NA-251). Modelled as one collector per bank; short cast-manifold primaries (0.45 m, unequal by +/-0.05 m) are estimates.
notes.exhaust.merge: [E] The crossover (X-pipe, H-pipe or none) is not confirmed for the factory system (research gap). An X-pipe with 0.35 crossover, as for GM's other cross-plane cars here: the reference LT4 recording heard from behind shows strong even orders and half orders 24-40 dB below the firing order, a strongly merged sound.
notes.exhaust.outlets: [P] Two outlets, each to a pair of tips at the outer corners of the diffuser (quad tips, Commons photo). Pipe lengths from the 4.8 m body (manifolds behind the front axle, mufflers at the rear) and the 76 mm (3 in) pipe diameter are estimates; the right pipe is 0.1 m longer (routing). Both outlets are equidistant from the listener (offsetM 0, a chase camera behind the car): heard from behind, the two banks sum almost in phase, so the half orders stay 15-30 dB under the firing order on throttle, as in the reference LT4 recording (9-28 dB under in free revs, 21-41 under driving away). A 0.25 m offset put them above the firing order.
notes.exhaust.muffler: [P]/[E] Dual-mode exhaust: electronically actuated valves let the gas bypass the rear mufflers; open on demand (Sport) and always in Track. Modelled as Sport: valves shut at light load below 3,500 rpm, open on throttle or above it. Filter values are the defaults.
notes.exhaust.evoDeg: [E] Default; LT4 cam 189/223 degrees at 0.050 in, 120-degree lobe separation [P] puts exhaust opening near 130 degrees after firing.
notes.exhaust.gasTempK: [E] Slightly above the default: supercharged engine at full load.
notes.exhaust.rasp: [E] 'Angry, hard-edged growl' (review snippet): a little more than the default 0.35.
notes.intake: [E] The intake breathes through the blower (throttle, rotors, intercooler bricks), which smooths the induction pulses: low level. Short runners in the blower lid; airbox fed from the front fascia.
notes.mechanical: [E] Pushrod OHV with hydraulic roller lifters (valvetrain slightly above the default), direct injection (injector ticks on) [F].
notes.idle.lope: [E] Mild cam (wide 120-degree lobe separation [P]): little lope.
notes.overrun.burble: [F]/[E] GM bulletin 17-NA-078: 'pop' or 'backfire' sounds during wide-open-throttle manoeuvres in Sport or Track are normal; reviewers mention 'exhaust blatting on the overrun'. Burble level 0.4 is an estimate.
notes.forcedInduction: [P] Eaton R1740 TVS: twin-rotor Roots type, two 4-lobe rotors with 160-degree twist, driven at 3.10 x crank speed (20,150 rotor rpm at 6,500) (EngineLabs, Corvette Action Center).
notes.forcedInduction.pulsesPerRev: [E] 8 pulses per rotor turn (2 rotors x 4 lobes), the standard twin-rotor relation: whine = rpm / 60 x 3.10 x 8 = 0.4133 x rpm Hz (engine order 24.8, 6.2 x the firing frequency): 269 Hz at idle, 1,240 Hz at 3,000 rpm, 2,728 Hz at 6,600. The weaker single-rotor line at half that pitch is not modelled (the synthesizer has no subharmonic option).
notes.forcedInduction.whineRpm: [E] Whine loops made at 1,200 and 4,000 rpm so the game's playback speed stays within 0.54-1.65 from idle to the limiter.
notes.limiter: [E] Not documented: fuel cut at about 6,600 rpm. Free revving bounces deeper and a little slower than in gear. Rates and drops are estimates.
notes.loops: [E] Default rpm points (idle to the limiter, about 1.29x apart).
notes.loudness.interior: [E] Research estimate: idle about 54 dBA, full throttle about 85, 70 mph about 70 (from Edmunds' previous-generation ZL1 convertible, 53.6 / 81.9 / 69.9 dB, adjusted for the coupe's louder valved exhaust). Car and Driver's figures for this car could not be read (gap). cruiseDbA is for reference; the level model uses idle and full throttle.
notes.loudness.loadRangeDb: [E] Default difference between closed and full throttle at the same rpm.
